title: Fresh Animations x Bare Bones Pixel Consistent Cave Spiders
description: Remodels the cave spider so it's no longer a scaled down version of the regular spider
body:
This pack remodels the cave spider so that it's no longer a downscaled version of the regular spider. 

This means its pixel scaling is now consistent with the environment, much like how Mojang did with the tiny takeover update.

---

Requires [_Entity Model Features_](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) (or Optifine) and [_Fresh Animations_](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) version 1.10.0 or higher.

This is the version supporting fresh animations. You can find the vanilla version [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-pixel-consistent-cave-spiders).
\
Note that this is _not_ an addon pack. You will not need the vanilla version if you use the fresh animations one.
